# NeoK12

> > Educational platform providing K-12 students with interactive science, geography, and social studies content through videos, quizzes, and games.

NeoK12 offers comprehensive learning resources across STEM subjects including biology (DNA, cells, photosynthesis), earth science (oceans, natural disasters), astronomy (stars, comets), chemistry (periodic table), and physics (sound). The platform features interactive diagrams, quiz games, educational videos, and hands-on science experiments designed for classroom and home learning.

## Key Topics

- K-12 Education
- Educational Videos
- Interactive Quizzes
- Science Games
- STEM Learning
- Biology & Anatomy
- Earth Science & Geography
- Astronomy & Space
- Chemistry & Physics
- Classroom Activities
- Ocean Science
- Genetics & DNA
- Educational Diagrams
- Science Experiments
- Quiz Games

## Life Sciences & Biology

- [Genetics Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Genetics.htm): Interactive genetics quizzes covering DNA, RNA, and Mendel's Laws
- [Skeletal System for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Skeletal-System.htm): Human anatomy content covering bones, joints & skeletal structure
- [Photosynthesis for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Photosynthesis.htm): Plant biology lessons covering photosynthesis, Calvin cycle & ATP
- [Cell Structures Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Cell-Structures.htm): Biology quizzes on cell organelles, prokaryotic/eukaryotic cells

## Earth & Space Sciences

- [Oceans - Geography Games and Videos](https://www.neok12.com/Oceans.htm): Educational content on 5 oceans with videos, quizzes & interactive games
- [Planet Earth - Science Games and Videos](https://www.neok12.com/Earth.htm): Earth science lessons on geology, structure & Earth-Sun-Moon system
- [Stars Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Stars.htm): Astronomy quizzes covering stars, Sun, and stellar lifecycle
- [Comets for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Comets.htm): Astronomy lessons on comets, asteroids & Solar System with NASA content
- [Types of Rocks Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Types-of-Rocks.htm): Geology quizzes on rock cycle, minerals, and plate tectonics
- [Natural Disasters - Geography Games and Videos](https://www.neok12.com/Natural-Disasters.htm): Geography education on natural disasters with videos and quizzes

## Physical Sciences

- [Periodic Table for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Periodic-Table.htm): Chemistry education on elements, atomic structure & Mendeleev's table
- [Sound - Science Games and Videos](https://www.neok12.com/Sound.htm): Physics lessons on sound waves, hearing, and human ear with quizzes
- [Energy Sources Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Energy-Sources.htm): Quiz games on renewable energy and natural resources for students

## Interactive Learning Tools

- [Science Experiments for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Science-Experiments.htm): Step-by-step science experiment videos for hands-on K12 learning
- [Interactive Diagrams](https://www.neok12.com/diagrams.htm): Labeling diagrams for biology, anatomy & human body systems
- [Slide Puzzles](https://www.neok12.com/slide-puzzles.htm): Interactive slide puzzles for STEM education across K12 subjects

## Language Arts & Social Studies

- [English Grammar Quiz Games](https://www.neok12.com/quiz/Grammar.htm): Grammar practice quiz games covering parts of speech for K12 students
- [Armed Forces - Social Studies Games and Videos](https://www.neok12.com/Armed-Forces.htm): US military education covering Army, Marine Corps & armed services

## Optional

- [Play Reversi - Educational Games and Puzzles](https://www.neok12.com/games/reversi/reversi.htm): Strategy board game with computer opponent for brain training
- [Magic Tricks for Kids](https://www.neok12.com/Learn-Magic-Tricks.htm): Step-by-step magic trick tutorials covering card and coin illusions
